rulings: R64b (2026-09-18). The engine WITHHELD on the re-pointed holding - 'no-checklist-match ... image-variation-refractor ... identitySource ingest-auto-seed, backing self-derived-only' - and it was right: the destination R64 chose was an auto-seed row, not a checklist row. This list moves the rows onto checklist-backed addresses.

THE HYPOTHESIS WAS THAT #221-225 ARE THE IMAGE-VARIATION CARDS. TWO SOURCES SAY OTHERWISE, and the correction matters. Cardboard Connection: the base set is '220 cards numbered 1-220'; cards 221-225 are 'not part of the main base set' but the 'Extended Base Short Prints' subset - '#221 Bobby Witt Jr. (Kansas City Royals RC)'. checklistcenter lists 'Extended Base SP Set (5 cards: #221-225)' and a SEPARATE 'Base Image Variation Set (20 cards)' whose numbers are 1, 6, 14, 35, 66, 74, 81, 96, 99, 113, 128, 129, 133, 150, 165, 166, 177, 200, 201, 220 - and states Witt #221 'appears ONLY in the Extended Base SP Set, not in the Image Variations section (which tops out at #220)'.

SO THE CONCLUSION HOLDS BY A DIFFERENT ROUTE: there is no flagship image-variation card at #221 at all. #221 IS the short print. Every 'SP' and 'Variation' word in these titles names that short print, so the cards are simply #221 Refractor and #221 base. This also explains Beckett's SP/SSP image-variation list stopping at 220, which the acquisition note opened under R64 flagged as unresolved - it is now resolved: nothing is missing from Beckett, #221 was never in that set.

DESTINATIONS ARE CHECKLIST-BACKED, which is the whole point. `:221:refractor:no-auto` is baseballcardpedia-ladders-2026-08-29 and `:221:base:no-auto` is beckett-scraped-2026-08-25; catalogAuthorityOf returns `checklist` for both (against `derived` for the ingest-auto-seed row the rows sit on now). Point-read confirmed both exist.

CORROBORATION FROM THE POOL ITSELF: `:221:refractor:no-auto` already holds one sale - '2022 Topps Chrome Sonic Bobby Witt JR SP Rookie Refractor #221' ($275 raw). A title carrying BOTH 'Sonic' and 'SP Refractor' was already filed on the flagship refractor row, which is the same reading this list applies to the other six.

THE TWO PARKED SALES ARE UN-PARKED ONTO BASE. 'BOBBY WITT JR 2022 TOPPS CHROME SP PSA 10 IMAGE VARIATION RC #221' ($1,050 and $725) state SP and IMAGE VARIATION but NO finish word. Since #221 is not in the image-variation set, 'IMAGE VARIATION' is the seller describing the short print; with no finish stated the card is the base SP. This retires the R64 park and the acquisition question behind it.
AXIS: setKey is unchanged (topps-chrome throughout); only `parallel` moves. cardNumber, isAuto and every trailing segment carry through byte-identical.

RETIRE CANDIDATES, reported NOT actioned here (a retire is the catalog lane's, and these rows may still be referenced): `:221:image-variation-refractor:no-auto` (ingest-auto-seed + its psa-9/psa-10 graded twins), `:221:refractor-image-variation:no-auto` (ebay-user-purchase), `:221:image-variation-sonic:no-auto` (cardpedia-drew-ruling-2026-09-11). All three are self-derived or ruling-minted addresses for a card the checklists do not carry. The Sonic Lite `:image-variations:` row is NOT a retire candidate - it is checklistcenter-backed and holds the 6 Sonic sales.
